title.zh: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
title.en: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit

current_state.zh: The SEC has opened a five-year experimental pathway for tokenized U.S. stock trading, benefiting DeFi-style venues, tokenization firms, and liquidity providers while excluding synthetic stock tokens from the framework.
current_state.en: The SEC has opened a five-year experimental pathway for tokenized U.S. stock trading, benefiting DeFi-style venues, tokenization firms, and liquidity providers while excluding synthetic stock tokens from the framework.
